title: Complexity-sensitive additive energy and off-diagonal Young inequalities on bounded-degree algebraic varieties
summary: We develop additive-energy estimates and weighted Young inequalities for finite sets on bounded-degree real algebraic varieties. For an irreducible $m$-dimensional variety $V$, let $σ(V)=2m-\dim\overline{V-V}^{\mathrm{Zar}}$ and $α(V)=\max{2,1+\frac{2σ(V)}{m}}$. For every $a\in[α(V),3)$ we define a finite-degree translation-partition flag parameter $Λ_{a,R}(X;V)$ and prove $E(X)\ll Λ_{a,R}(X;V)^{3-a}|X|^{a+\varepsilon}$. This recovers the line-concentration theorem of Jing and Wu for algebraic surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$. For codimension-two quadratic threefolds…
